scientific_integrity: The Apéry/representation preliminaries and preceding p<=floor(a/2) classification are attributed to published work; no independent verification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The result treats the ray p=floor(a/2)+5 for a>=7 only; first failure threshold and exact embedding dimension are not determined. Symbolic proof is supplemented, not replaced, by finite tests. Potential unindexed prior equivalences remain.
title: A uniform non-maximal-embedding-dimension family beyond the known three-coin p-Apéry range
